title: Construct the complete P104 backward word with zero-restored collectors
body:
PR2458 verifies the forward P104 two-target word and individual native edge adjoints, while explicitly leaving the complete COPY/discard backward program open. This package emits the complete backward logical inverse-transpose in reversed endpoint charts, with all eight private collectors restored to zero before erasure.

The 4,982-event word transposes every event of the full 4,734-event predecessor, applies 208 source sign operations, and cleans every collector. After a collector gathers unchanged D inputs, climbs rank seven and updates its Q owner, it returns to the line chart and subtracts those D inputs. The checker binds the complete lifetime and verifies that Q is disjoint from every unchanged gather source. Exact replay covers all 358 arbitrary boundary inputs and all 128,164 endpoint coefficients, including restoration of 150 dirty helpers and zero at every private erasure. It checks `S^T D=I` and distinguishes C from C^T using the asymmetric two-target correction.

All 1,654 transport occurrences bind to 909 native directed frame pairs. The complete adjoints and 208 intrinsic endpoint adjoints are checked with the credited signed-Pauli/exact-Gaussian interpreter, including phase. Retained inverse Fourier blocks are explicitly rewritten as one positive Fourier child plus a charged XOR adapter. The full positive profile is `1216H1+74H2+86H3+104H4+48H5+42H6+76H7+8H8`, rank mass 3,126. Zero restoration costs exactly eight H7 returns and 32 ADDs beyond the 3,070-mass direct adjoint word, which is retained as an explicit comparison. The return transports use already certified forward native operators.

The precise physical boundary is `Gamma_initial * S^-T * Gamma_final^-1`. This is not a claim of physical `F^-T`, complementary-frame monotone admission, or a full paired supplier. The final construction needs one reusable zero-initialized private register and no nonzero-discard permission. Physical initialization/erasure/scalar routing, recursive owners/idle/residual billing, precision and all-size admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-record change is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-owned-collector-dual
python3.12 -I -O -B research/p104-owned-collector-dual/verify.py
```

Validation includes twelve semantic controls, an accepted equivalent sign ordering, exact regeneration of both words, Git-free read-only export, missing/corrupted evidence, source drift before executable import, typed receipt corruption and exclusive output checks. Separate AI peer review covers the complete adjoint and zero-return extension. Local registered checks use Python 3.12.14. Hosted CI and human/proof-kernel review are not claimed.

Only `research/p104-owned-collector-dual/` is added. Exact main base is `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Predecessors are PR2458 head `3170afd2fc13a990bfe28f5ab6421bcda4ffd0f6` and its retained PR2445 word, with exact blob/SHA256 bindings. The changed picker scope and concrete next interface questions are recorded in TASK.json/README.

Final overlap covers 683 open PRs at 12:29:09 UTC on 2026-10-15. The Discussion refresh hit GitHub's GraphQL rate limit; the last complete snapshot contains 1,192 records at 12:04:33 UTC. REST confirmed the exact PR2458 head remains unchanged and inspected nearby PR2479 head `65e58f85d98b4a6344c6221623df1d4caa519604`: its original uncorrected G/2 macro dual explicitly retains a nonzero-discard accumulator contract. This contribution covers the corrected 358-input word, states backward chart coordinates precisely, and restores private storage to zero with the complete additional local bill. This bounded overlap is not a novelty certificate or complete arbitrary-diff search.

Credit PR2458 for its native certificates and backward handoff; Ross Richardson/PR2445, commdata2338/PR2393, Hiroki Kumazaki/PR2353, Philippe Van Velzen, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Rohan Arun/PR1972, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125/1862, icekylinx/PR531 and the retained compiler/interpreter ancestry. Predecessor files and notices remain unchanged. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, proof, code, tests and writing, including separate AI peer review. New work is Apache-2.0.
